$comment: Owner rule 2026-11-17: one experiments section steers HSK AI content from script to result. Rules and owner view: content/EXPERIMENTS.md. Engine: scripts/experiments.mjs (npm run content:experiments). Per-video records: content/feedback/publications.json (scripts/publication-ledger.mjs). Weekly reviews are dated files in content/feedback/reports/. Only the owner promotes a style or changes a permanent rule.

accepted.note: Only provider-certified exact post-age 168h observations qualify for a promotion recommendation.

directional.note: Daily Feedback captures the earliest lifetime snapshot from 7d to under 8d post age, with exact age reported. This is NOT a 7d period and is NEVER counted as decision-eligible.

resultWindow.note: A lifetime snapshot after 7 days is not an exact 7d result. No automatic or unverified winner.

unchanged: calendar.json dates, weekly content mix and publishing times
owner approval of every exact final video before publication
CTA Lab wording, voice profile and approved/published history

experiments.hypothesis: Opening a lesson with a common learner mistake and its correction (B) brings more HSK AI link requests per 1000 views than opening with a quick challenge (A, the current style). Both are complete, equally useful lessons; only the opening differs.

arms.name: Challenge → Answer → Practice
arms.scriptBrief: Arm A (current style). Open in the first 1-2 seconds with a quick challenge the viewer can try: one concrete beginner question about the lesson's Chinese point (choose, guess or complete). Give the truthful answer early (within the first 30%), then teach the point completely with the lesson's examples, and end the teaching body with a short practice the viewer can do aloud (recall or say the example). Do not open with a wrong form. Keep the topic, examples, CTA, voice, visual system and duration band as the lesson already requires.

arms.name: Mistake → Correction → Practice
arms.scriptBrief: Arm B (candidate). Open in the first 1-2 seconds with one real, common beginner mistake about the lesson's Chinese point, clearly marked as wrong (never present a wrong form as correct). Correct it right away with the right form and the reason (within the first 30%), then teach the point completely with the lesson's examples, and end the teaching body with a short practice the viewer can do aloud (recall or say the example). Do not open with a quiz question. Keep the topic, examples, CTA, voice, visual system and duration band as the lesson already requires.

constants: topic and examples from the calendar

assignment.note: The arm with fewer assignments goes next; a tie takes the arm opposite the latest one. Assignments are stored here and never hand-picked by topic.

knownConfounders: Weekday differs; alternation over three lessons a week rotates it.
Setting: the two first videos were drawn before this test (office for A, metro for B). The visual setting-group test is paused, so later settings do not follow the arm.

experiments.hypothesis: Naming and showing HSK AI in the first two seconds and then a real product demo (B) keeps more viewers to the brand ending and reaches more people than the current advertisement style (A). The goal stays brand recall.

arms.name: Current advertisement style
arms.scriptBrief: Arm A (current style). Follow content/PROMO_WORKFLOW.md as today: one recognisable life situation tied to one real product benefit, the brand cues early and again at the brand ending.

arms.name: Early brand + real product demo
arms.scriptBrief: Arm B (candidate). Say and show the HSK AI name and logo in the first two seconds, then show a real product demo from real product evidence (a real screen recording or capture of the HSK AI feature; never a fake or invented screenshot) solving the situation, then the unchanged brand ending.

experiments.hypothesis: A micro-drama with one recurring HSK AI hero and a story that continues across weekends (B) grows more followers per 1000 views than the current self-contained two-part stories (A).

arms.name: Current two-part story
arms.scriptBrief: Arm A (current style). Follow creative-formats.json#storytellingPolicy.seriesPartPolicy: one two-part story, resolved in part 2.

arms.name: Micro-Drama
arms.scriptBrief: Arm B (candidate). One recurring HSK AI cast member is the hero of a continuing story across weekends; each part still teaches one complete Chinese point on its own and never withholds its answer; the honest teaser rules of seriesPartPolicy apply.

experiments.rule: Both parts of one story are always in the same arm; part 1 and part 2 of one story are never compared as A and B.

linkedTests.reason: Only one test runs at a time (owner rule 2026-11-17). Its recorded arms stay in content/lesson-art/*.json#variety; it can resume only as the single active test after lesson-opening-v1 is decided.
